title: NGC-404: Fractured Sector small gameplay preview
author: WoodpeckerFancy9436
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I wanted to share a short gameplay video showing what a typical journey in **NGC-404: Fractured Sector** might look like, enjoy!

This project started before AI was actually good enough to let it code, but now it can help with development process.

Also if you have any questions or want to share your thoughts feel free to do just that. :)  
This is still work in progress.

Steam page:  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4451910?utm\_source=red\_ng](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4451910?utm_source=red_ng)

comments.body: ...Is this a decompile of Starsector that you couldn't even be bothered to give a distinct name to, or just a clone?

replies.author: WoodpeckerFancy9436
replies.body: Neither. This is godot not java, and starsector doesn't have multiplayer so this is a completely different game design.
